what: The motion clear moved from per picture to per macroblock, measured alone.
commit: the motion-clear commit of round 3; before is its parent

machine.cpu: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.90GHz, 4 physical cores / 8 threads

method: Both binaries built --profile dist from the same tree, differing only in the change. taskset -c 2, one warm-up each, then 13 rounds with the order alternated each round. The statistic is the per-round paired ratio after/before.
why_it_matters: The instruction count says nothing and the clock says 5.3% (the paired median of 0.947). The change removes about 2.6 MB of stores a picture at 1080p rather than work, and an instruction count does not see memory traffic. Four changes in the same round did the opposite: instructions down, clock unmoved.
caveat: 13 rounds on one stream, not the eight-stream paired set the round's cumulative figure uses. One round of the 13 read 1.077. The round-3 cumulative A/B covers this change together with the rest: see round3-cumulative-ab.json.
